body.statement: For every interior \(\rho_0\in(-r,r)\), can the handle \(\mathfrak G_{K,T,H}(\rho_0)\) establish the deterministic-shell local asymptotic minimax identity \(\lim_{T\to\infty}\lim_{H\to\infty}\liminf_{K\to\infty}\inf_{D_K\in\mathscr D_K}\sup_{\mathcal H_K(\rho_0,H)}\mathbb E\,\ell_T(\sqrt{\lambda_K}(D_K-L_K))=V(\rho_0)\), where \(\mathscr D_K\) contains every randomized measurable Markov kernel from \(\mathcal O_K\) to \(\mathcal D=[a-b,a+b]\), with \(H\) taken to infinity before \(T\), and with \(\operatorname{clip}_{\mathcal D}(\widehat L_K)\) attaining the corresponding upper bound, equivalently with \(\widehat L_K\) attaining it in the real-valued formulation?
body.justification: This is the genuine open content needed to certify that the Gaussian variance is an efficiency bound for the full deterministic-array problem rather than only for a mixture experiment.
body.gap: Hirano and Porter transfer bounded local risks from limit experiments, and Kipnis conditions Poisson mixtures to fixed counts; neither derandomizes onto exact two-array Hamming shells with a realized-target centering error that is negligible at collision scale.
body.consumer: A positive resolution certifies the collision estimator as locally minimax and prevents marginal-imbalance information in hand-picked arrays from invalidating the lower bound.
